tagline: A portfolio-grade, Azure/Fabric-focused real-time transport data platform — synthetic data only.
summary: TransitPulse models a fictional Sydney public transport operator running buses, routes, stops and depots, so that production-style batch and streaming data engineering can be demonstrated end to end without touching any real operator's systems or data.

A deterministic simulator generates vehicle telemetry, scheduled trips, passenger journeys and service incidents. That synthetic stream feeds a medallion-style Bronze/Silver/Gold pipeline, data-quality and quarantine logic, and (once the Microsoft Fabric trial is activated) Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse and real-time processing.
This website is the public-facing reviewer experience. It is explicitly DEMO mode everywhere right now: every page uses hand-authored static fixtures, not a live or connected backend, and says so.
architectureTeaser: Data moves through a Bronze (raw, replayable), Silver (validated, deduplicated, quarantine-routed) and Gold (business/analytics-ready) layering. The same synthetic telemetry stream is used to demonstrate event-time vs. processing-time handling, windowing, late/duplicate/out-of-order events and incident-driven recovery, all runnable locally before any paid Fabric capacity is involved.
